full_judgment: 23. It is here that Mr Ragib Rouf Chowdhury has submitted that any scope left in Rule 61(4) for a transportation of the standards of the Code in giving effect to the legislative intent of limiting the time for disposal of Election cases can still be availed of to the fullest upon a proper juxtaposition of the provisions of Rule 60 vis-a-vis Rule 61(4). Here Mr Chowdhury argues that the provisions of Order XVIII, Rule 19(2) serve as a bridge for a proper understanding and construction of the computation of limitation period in Rule 61(4) given that one is here dealing with a Tribunal that necessarily can only be seized of and actively conduct proceedings during working days. The test here is to give a reasonable construction to the mechanism of computation of time in Rule 61(4) given the reality of the workings and administration of cases by an Election Tribunal.
